as_of.initialization_note: Arlequino and Rena have left the hotel room and are walking through Dwargon. Rena has resumed the organizer and Eurazania-information errands through a plausible guild/caravan/merchant contact route. No contact result is established yet. Students and Bren continue independent Gvazimodo preparation.

processes.objective: Find an organizer/coordinator for concerts and broader creative/operational work.
processes.current_state: Rena has resumed the task after leaving the hotel. She and Arlequino are en route toward a plausible guild/caravan/merchant information area where she intends to seek people who know event organizers/coordinators. No organizer has yet been contacted or secured.
constraints: Scope is broader than one concert.
Rena chooses her own method consistent with character and knowledge.
No organizer acceptance may be fabricated before contacts and time exist.
advance_when: Rena reaches a plausible contact point.
A named or role-based intermediary is causally encountered.
A real organizer candidate is identified or contacted.

processes.objective: Determine through causal in-world channels where Eurazania evacuees were sent and where they can currently be found.
processes.current_state: Rena has resumed the inquiry after leaving the hotel. She is heading toward guild/caravan/merchant channels that may carry recent travel and refugee information. No source has yet been questioned and no destination is established.
processes.location_context: Dwargon with inquiry targets potentially outside Dwargon
constraints: No omniscient access to evacuation records.
Results require plausible sources and delays.
Exact evacuee distribution remains unresolved until causally learned.
dependencies: Access to people or institutions carrying post-Eurazania information.
Travel or message delay where sources are not local.
advance_when: A causal local source is reached.
A report, traveler, caravan contact or official provides partial information.

processes.objective: Begin gathering realistic new-home options for Rena and Arlequino.
processes.current_state: The couple has left the hotel, but Rena is sequencing organizer and Eurazania-information work first. No property contact or option is yet established.
constraints: Exact budget is unresolved; family funds are approximately ~358g.
Final purchase decision is not delegated.
Property availability, price, ownership, access and transaction time must be respected.
advance_when: Rena finishes or pauses the first inquiry route.
She encounters a plausible property-information channel.

processes.objective: Develop and stage «Гвазимодо» with the Dwargon students.

Students continue self-organized rehearsal and production work. Bren continues refining a first-pass availability picture and grouping plausible rehearsal blocks, but no final schedule is fixed because the concert date remains unknown and some individual confirmations may still be outstanding.
constraints: Dain remains the tree as punishment unless changed.
Jobs, fatigue, venue access, meals, travel and other obligations limit rehearsal time.
Concert date is not yet fixed.
dependencies: Concert date clarification by Arlequino today or tomorrow.

processes.objective: Simulate continuing consequences of the capital's destruction.
processes.current_state: The T+161 destruction anchor remains in aftermath. World-side consequences continue, but exact refugee distribution, exact home-level damage and exact information reach into Dwargon remain unresolved unless separately established. Rena has now started seeking causal information through local travel/trade/guild networks.
constraints: Do not reveal hidden world-side facts directly to Arlequino.
Do not invent exact casualty numbers or refugee destinations.
Carrion's true survival remains restricted until canonically revealed.

Arlequino or Rena interacts with affected networks.

maintenance.on_substantial_time_advance: Review every relevant active process and persist justified partial progress, blocking reason, completion or failure.
